source.notes: Four separately fitted houses around an asymmetric courtyard: Ba Sing Se, Cahuilla, Chatsubo and Huaqiangbei. Native aerial c273 constrains roof centers and unequal roof depths; broad rack-supported stairs and seven travel trailers replace generic templates. Dimensions and hidden interiors remain approximate.
limitations: Rack bays set to nominal 12 ft. Photographic placement is approximate; this is not a measured inventory or survey.

bands.note: low prisms = geometry within the ground body band; .up = above it (overhead). No walkable decks/stairs: none are declared by the procedural scene.
